Tomás made a measurable contribution by improving routing efficiency by 18%. He also worked well with colleagues across the team, bringing a practical, cooperative approach to day-to-day logistics challenges.

I am confident that Tomás’s experience, dependability, and teamwork will make him a strong addition to your organization. I recommend him for this opportunity.
